title: QTCinderella’s homophobic friends controversy explained: Streamer under fire over past comments
summary_full: QTCinderella has responded after renewed criticism over claims that she associates with “homophobic people.” The streamer explained that she believes kindness and personal relationships can help people reconsider harmful beliefs. She also admitted that her comments from a year ago were poorly worded and said she is not friends with bigots. After more confusion online, she shared a longer explanation on her main X account.
